labels.name: 🏷️ Bug
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Reports a defect or proposes its fix; does not imply confirmation or approval.

labels.name: 🧭 Needs Triage
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Initial repository triage is still missing; remove after that triage.

labels.name: 🧭 Needs Testing
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Requested testing or verification evidence is missing; remove when supplied.

labels.name: ⏳ Stale
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Meets the adopted inactivity rule; the active warning still governs closure.

labels.name: ⏳ Awaiting Response
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] A concrete request awaits a reply; remove when the wait ends.

labels.name: ⏳ Awaiting Release
labels.description: [ISSUE] Implemented on the named development line, but not yet in stable main source.

labels.name: 🛠️ Keep Open
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Exempt from general inactivity closure; remove when protection no longer applies.

labels.name: 🛠️ Manual Triage
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Pause managed labels and policy replies until this is removed.

labels.name: 🛠️ No Auto-reply
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Suppress policy replies only; factual label reconciliation continues.

labels.name: 📏 Size: XS
labels.description: [PR] 0-19 review lines after exclusions; paired replacements count once, not a risk estimate.

labels.name: 📏 Size: S
labels.description: [PR] 20-99 review lines after exclusions; paired replacements count once, not a risk estimate.

labels.name: 📏 Size: M
labels.description: [PR] 100-499 review lines after exclusions; paired replacements count once, not a risk estimate.

labels.name: 📏 Size: L
labels.description: [PR] 500-999 review lines after exclusions; paired replacements count once, not a risk estimate.

labels.name: 📏 Size: XL
labels.description: [PR] 1000+ review lines after exclusions; paired replacements count once, not a risk estimate.

labels.name: 📏 Size: Unknown
labels.description: [PR] A complete meaningful review-line count is unavailable; inspect the recorded reason.

labels.name: 🏷️ Feature
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Proposes or adds a new capability; not a commitment to build it.

labels.name: 🏷️ Improvement
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Improves an existing capability rather than primarily fixing a defect.

labels.name: 🏷️ Refactor
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Restructures implementation without an intended behaviour change.

labels.name: 🏷️ Documentation
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Documentation is the primary requested or delivered outcome.

labels.name: 🏷️ Tests
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Test coverage or test infrastructure is the primary outcome.

labels.name: 🏷️ Maintenance
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Dependency, tooling, or repository upkeep is the primary outcome.

labels.name: 🧭 Needs Information
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] Requested facts are missing; remove when the specific information is supplied.

labels.name: 🧭 Needs Reproduction
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] A requested reproducer or reproduction result is missing; remove when supplied.

labels.name: 🧭 Needs Explanation
labels.description: [ISSUE][PR] The requested intent or trade-off explanation is missing; remove when supplied.
